reviewer.independence: Independent from draft/implementation and TC authors. Owns only this review; static source/design/SQL/plan inspection, no implementation/tests/imports/SDK/services.

scope: Future I02 saved-request admission UI plan only. These are draft contract gaps, not newly demonstrated current-product vulnerabilities or blockers to the separately gated frozen V6 runtime attempt.
accepted_direction: Use existing experiments/ifpmic-live/web and launcher; keep src/ifpmic/WorkflowPage.tsx design/replay scope unchanged.
Require actual fullH2 acceptance before product implementation. Accepted152/source/pre-gates are not actual490 or UI acceptance.
Preserve durable202 create/replay, idempotency, read-only GETs, authenticated visibility, epoch guards, immutable original design, role boundaries and private evidence.
QUEUED is only initial B03 projection, not workflow completion, human approval or full AT acceptance.

findings.finding: The read endpoint/DTO/null-state/receipt predicate remains a choice, and425 is treated as an admission-pending option without an existing contract. Current visible job/command reads return200, including DRAFT/accepted; ApiError and original OpenAPI define no425.
findings.required_revision: Choose one additive versioned admission route and exact response schema before code. Preserve200 safe pending,401 authentication,403 FORBIDDEN for invalid/missing/invisible IDs, and503 dependency/consistency failure; do not introduce425 implicitly. Specify nulls and pending/admitted-without-receipt/applied/rejected/quarantined/unavailable outcomes. QUEUED needs a consistent same-project/job/create-command/admitted-run/sequence1 applied receipt tuple with the actual command/job revision/state, not merely a nonempty run or any receipt. Keep202 replay and409 changed-body semantics unchanged.

findings.finding: The draft phrase owner or membership/delegation can weaken the real predicate, and neither read alternative fixes the DB trust boundary. Existing API end-user auth is Session-based; its DB runtime login is shared. A job-only function or caller actor_id/GUC cannot itself prove browser ownership.
findings.required_revision: State the exact predicate: active membership AND(owner OR unrevoked/unexpired job.read delegation). Fix the shared API runtime as the trusted service caller and API Session as end-user authority; do not claim session_user authenticates the browser actor. Choose a least-privilege read function owner/grantee/search_path/return set and a single statement snapshot joining current visibility to the read result, not a stale precheck followed by an unrelated fetch. No browser actor/owner/project/grant parameter or caller GUC may supply authority. Preserve direct execution-table denial and no owner/dispatcher/projector credential in the API.

findings.finding: Supervising only Temporal,dispatcher and worker does not complete the existing saved-request path. POST creates workspace_intents in RESERVED. Actual reserve_execution refuses non-READY workspaces, and the H2 normal flow explicitly runs WorkspaceService.reconcile_once. The launcher also lacks fixed runtime registration/config/interpreter/persistence/readiness/cleanup decisions.
findings.required_revision: Include the existing G5 workspace reconciler and private workspace root with real token/generation/marker READY proof; never update READY manually. Fix the reviewed process/interpreter/config/registered deployment-build-role-OID/Temporal endpoint and persistent store sequence, ownership, ports, startup failure and shared-deadline shutdown/restart behavior. Define handling of existing saved pending requests without resetting I02 data. Pin the intentional context-version/validation change because current validateContext rejects execution_connected=true; the flag cannot substitute for observed admission.

findings.finding: Calling raw job/command/run IDs a safe DTO does not define their authenticated-display versus public-evidence policy. Also, I02 server-restart evidence does not establish recovery when a fresh browser context loses sessionStorage pending key/body; automatic same-key recovery cannot be assumed in that case.
findings.required_revision: Classify each identifier and permit only explicitly authorized DTO fields; separately specify redaction/normalization for screenshots,URLs/logs and public proof. IDs are neither automatically public-safe nor automatically forbidden in authenticated UI. Define supported reload/server/browser restart behavior and a fail-closed storage-loss path: authenticated list/detail lookup without inventing a key or matching ambiguous requests as the same command. Keep tokens out of storage and all account/detail/command epoch guards.

findings.finding: REQ-05 is mislabeled as Temporal single-decision/outbox/version pin. The immutable requirement is preservation of human-owned steps, with AT-05 requiring human submission before advancing. B03 owns Temporal/outbox/version-pin deliverables and AT-05/16/29 as separate acceptance scopes.
findings.required_revision: Correct the derivative trace table, include REQ-12 for the user-visible read/interaction scope where applicable, and retain REQ-05/AT-05 as human-step invariants not proven by initial QUEUED. Preserve immutable source documents and incomplete AT-16/21/29/32 boundaries.

preferred_bounded_implementation_contrac.ui_and_route: Extend existing I02 web. Prefer an additive GET /api/v1/jobs/{job_id}/admission with an independently reviewed admission-status.v1 schema; leave original OpenAPI/design bytes and existing job/command response shapes unchanged.
preferred_bounded_implementation_contrac.read_trust: Keep existing auth.authenticate and JobService transaction as end-user boundary. Prefer one narrow read-only SQL STABLE SECURITY DEFINER function taking job_id only, granted EXECUTE solely to the API runtime service role, with fixed qualified relations/search_path and no PUBLIC grant. It exposes only minimal execution status fields. It does not claim per-browser-user SQL authentication: API shared runtime is explicitly trusted, just as existing JobService queries are.
preferred_bounded_implementation_contrac.query_authority: The API derives actor solely from the authenticated Session. Use one SELECT with exact existing VISIBLE predicate and a lateral/read-function result for that visible job, so authorization and tuple are evaluated under one statement snapshot. Invalid/missing/invisible IDs all become the same403. A caller-supplied actor/GUC is not accepted as proof. Fix function errors/cardinality and bounded fields so querying an invisible/missing ID exposes no existence through differentiated public errors.
preferred_bounded_implementation_contrac.tuple: Server-side read joins the actual job/create-command/project,binding admitted run and matching initial projection receipt. Define zero/one cardinalities,null behavior,applied/rejected outcomes and conflict handling in the additive contract. Existing200 pending is retained; missing or inconsistent proof never becomesQUEUED.
preferred_bounded_implementation_contrac.launcher_sequence: Use existing I02 API/PG/OIDC and durable requests. Mirror actual normal-flow prerequisites: source/environment/build/principal registration and private persistent Temporal/config; existing WorkspaceService reconciliation to real READY; pinned production dispatcher and worker; same-run admission/projector receipt; authorized API read; epoch-guarded display. Pin original32 API/workspace versus qualified SDK-runtime interpreter selection and every owned resource lifecycle before source approval.
preferred_bounded_implementation_contrac.verification: After actualH2 acceptance and V2 contract/source approval, fix exact API/SQL/launcher/browser cases before implementation execution: pending200,applied tuple,rejected/quarantine/dependency paths,authorization/delegation/revocation races,missing vs forbidden IDs,idempotency/response loss,workspace and runtime restart,storage loss/stale responses. Repin changed H2-covered sources and agree required fresh impact regressions; do not inherit a full490 pass for different relevant bytes.

next_action: Author a concrete V2 derivative plan/additive API-SQL contract resolving these choices and preserve this reviewed draft as lineage. Request bounded contract review before implementation. Existing gated V6 runtime work is independent.
